notes: I recognised the paper from its title as an existing arXiv paper but have no memory of its reviews or decision, and I reviewed it on its merits. The strict literature check's date filter and the arXiv-only index limited it: the query 'vision-language-action' counts as 3 words so 'VLA' had to be used, which returned radio-astronomy results; two later queries were refused for exceeding 4 words and no queries were rerun (C3 and benchmarks were left thin; `related_search.py benchmarks` returned an empty list for this robotics paper). The ledger prints dropped titles including post-cutoff work, which I did not open or use. The skill sets confidence-weighted EIC shares but R3 (confidence 3) with Overall 5 still moves the mean little; the 'criterion 3' table does not clearly cover benchmarks like LIBERO that have no separate validation split and no hidden test labels (simulator rollouts), so I had to judge between 'field practice' and 'benchmark with no validation split'; I chose MAJOR via the row where the main comparison holds across the sweep. Also ambiguous: the reviewer templates ask for Missing References 'verified with `verify`' but `verify` only searches arXiv, so peer-reviewed-only references cannot be confirmed. Figures were unavailable, so several numbers (Fig. 4, Fig. 5, Fig. 6) are text-extracted or unverified.
